item.title: Thursday 1 PM Update, Nov 26
item.description:
The Thanksgiving one o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 26, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather for the next 24 hours; storm outages climb past six hundred thousand as the Jersey Shore sees record tides, and about three hundred thousand legal immigrants get Medicare warning letters; two Italian technicians killed in a drone attack in Kuwait as Israel signals readiness to strike Iran, and Ukraine says North Korea has paused arms deliveries to Russia; a quick crypto check with Wall Street closed; a CBS investigation into Chinese-owned Nvidia partners and new benchmarks for Google and Amazon AI chips; Reuters on delays at two Chinese AI labs; a fake paid-interview phishing campaign and a Gmail-stealing fake Chrome extension; your X feed; Londonderry housing news and the Lancers' title game; and a Texas town that bought a new car for the woman who feeds it every Thanksgiving. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Thursday 10 AM Update, Nov 26
item.description:
The Thanksgiving ten o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 26, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather for the next 24 hours; New York declares a storm emergency as hundreds of flights are canceled, and a judge declines a longer ban on taxpayer-funded administration ads; Iran claims two more tankers hit mines near Hormuz, Ukraine strikes a Russian bomber base again, and EU leaders stay far apart on the budget; China warns of countermeasures over new tariffs as Black Friday forecasts point to records online; a report that the Pentagon weighed a wartime law over Nvidia's CEO, X adds parental controls and Neuralink wins approval for a pivotal trial; Claude rewrites Claude's own API in Rust, OpenAI tightens usage limits and New York bans AI chatbot toys; malware that hijacks your browser's management settings and European warnings about AI-agent hacking; your X feed; a deadly shooting at a Massachusetts Thanksgiving game and free holiday meals around New Hampshire; and a Maine father who fills an empty chair with a hundred guests. item.title: Thursday Morning, Nov 26
item.description:

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
